summary: Initializes an 11-dword structure. Stores the incoming pointer a2 at this+0x0, zeroes this+0x4 through this+0x10 and this+0x18, this+0x24, this+0x28, and writes sentinel values -1 at this+0x14 and this+0x1C. If a2 is non-null, reads a value through FieldGetter_79d0(a2) into this+0x20, otherwise this+0x20 keeps the default -1. Returns the initialized this pointer. Called by FileDataProcessor, suggesting file/data-processing setup.

operations.description: Seed the local default v3 with -1 before any conditional read.
Write the incoming pointer a2 into the first field at this+0x0.
Write the sentinel value -1 at this+0x14.
Write the sentinel value -1 at this+0x1C.
Guard: the conditional field read runs only when a2 is non-null.
Call FieldGetter_79d0(a2) to read a value from the referenced object and store it in v3.
Write v3 (the field-get result, or the default -1 when a2 was null) at this+0x20.
